title: File:US Navy 051111-N-8163B-032 An oil tanker docked to the Al Basrah Oil Terminal (ABOT) takes on crude oil in the Persian Gulf.jpg
art: U.S. Navy photo by Photographer's Mate Airman Eben Boothby
desc: Persian Gulf (Nov. 11, 2005) – An oil tanker docked to the Al Basrah Oil Terminal (ABOT) takes on crude oil in the Persian Gulf. Coalition forces have been training Iraqi personnel in force protection and search and seizure operations in effort to turn over the two oil terminals in the area to Iraq.
